description: This file defines the AlarmAdapter class, which manages the display and interaction with alarm data in a RecyclerView for an Android application. It handles binding alarms to views, deleting alarms, and ordering alarm items.

classes.name: AlarmAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class connecting alarm data to RecyclerView, handling alarm display and deletion.

classes.name: AlarmAdapter.AlarmViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to views for each alarm item.

classes.name: AlarmAdapter.DividerItemDecoration
classes.description: RecyclerView ItemDecoration that draws dividers between items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the alarm_row layout and creates a new AlarmViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds alarm data to the view for a given position, including setting times and delete actions.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of alarms in the list.

methods.name: addAlarm
methods.description: Adds a new alarm to the list and updates the view.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Removes an alarm from the list and updates the view.
